snippet.title: Galactum Meridian - Science-Focused Space 4X Gameplay
snippet.description:
Galactum Meridian is a science-focused space 4X game about exploring star systems, studying worlds, deploying probes, and competing for stewardship.
Early Access begins September 1:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4690110/Galactum_Meridian/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=indiegames_early_access_launch
